question: In the 2015/2016 season, which league had the most drawn matches and also featured at least one team with above-average build-up play passing in 2015?

prediction.sql:
SELECT t1."XCL_005"
FROM League AS t1
JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1."XCL_003" = t2."XCL_008"
WHERE t2."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  AND t2."XCL_015" = t2."XCL_016"
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Team AS t3
    JOIN Team_Attributes AS t4 ON t3."XCL_171" = t4."XCL_177"
    WHERE t3."XCL_171" IN (t2."XCL_013", t2."XCL_014")
      AND t4."XCL_178" LIKE '2015%'
      AND t4."XCL_181" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_181") FROM Team_Attributes WHERE "XCL_178" LIKE '2015%')
  )
GROUP BY t1."XCL_005"
ORDER BY COUNT(t2."XCL_006") DESC
LIMIT 1
